notes.note: Reviewed shared Inbox action claims in chat-composer, getting-started and responsive-ui against the real desktop menu, touch Snooze and mobile selection-to-Details callers. Deferring hidden action construction leaves the complete open Details action set, wake timestamps, pending commands, discard Undo and focus ownership unchanged; no authority cache, navigation, storage or motion contract changes. Original owning unit selection passed 71 tests. Extended approval browser cases passed at 390 and 1440px in both themes on the frozen measured candidate; inspected eight row/menu/Details PNGs at native size. Captures precede the unrelated turn-rail merge; they do not establish physical-mobile or native-shell behavior. Existing prose about action availability remains accurate for this change.

Reviewed chat-composer and getting-started action order, availability and Snooze choices against inboxRowActions and every production choices consumer. The factory captures the same caller-supplied now and resolves presets only for visible controls, rather than retaining an authority or result cache. The original full owning InboxRow/RowMenu selection passed 71 tests, including complete Details choices and exact wakeAt selection; the new closed-row cases failed before repair on eight locale-time formatting calls. No product-copy or user journey change is needed. Single-host profiling is diagnostic and does not qualify native hardware or field input latency.

Reviewed responsive-ui phone chat selection, reachable Details actions, menu focus and narrow geometry against MobileInboxPanel, MobileInboxSelection, shared InboxRow and the executed browser journey. Replaced the stale expectation of a per-row mobile Details icon with the documented Actions for Chats -> Select conversations -> row -> Details path; baseline 57ec dark-mobile reproduced the old missing-icon failure. All four extended viewport/theme cases passed on the measured production candidate, retaining exact approval dispatch and adding real Details/menu visibility plus desktop Escape focus return. Eight PNGs inspected at native size. This establishes fixture-backed Chromium integration, not physical-phone touch, native WebView, real-account or universal accessibility qualification.
